releases.name: opencode-music-player v0.9.0
releases.body:
Target the tested OpenCode 2.0.30 host contract and require music-core ^0.6.0. The host supplies OpenTUI 0.5.17, Solid 1.9.15, and Effect 4.0.1.

Users retaining OpenCode 2.0.28 should retain music-player 0.8.0.

Changes: [#272](https://github.com/naxodev/ai/pull/272).
